source_constants.name: IS_GS_EVENT
source_constants.pattern: \#define\ IS_GS_EVENT\(player,\ card,\ event\)\	\	\(IS_CASTING\(player,\ card,\ event\)\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_CHANGE_TARGET\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_CAN_CHANGE_TARGET\)

scope: One hundred complete October 2022 native card bodies reviewed:24 definitions updated and76 retained. Restore native attack/spell dispatch, aura event filtering, Quarantine Field multi-X payment and actual isolation count, Tendo Ice Bridge mana tracking, Puncture Blast extension keywords, Whippoorwill targeted no-repeat legacy and spell cleanup. Native quirks retained, including Simoon conditional self-destruction, Hoofprints absent turn restriction and Ground Assault sacrifice cleanup. Original source names/interfaces preserved. Full aligned owner assembly resolves packed attacker bytes, damage-source coordinates, extension offsets and Tendo mana globals/parent coordinates.117 native callee identities,112 enum values,4 complete source dependency bodies and83 data ranges bound. Independent callees and gameplay remain separately tracked; no byte matching or whole-program equivalence claim.
